title: Pull block from guarded zone using hooked rod into tray without crossing line
instruction: Pull the block out of the guarded zone with the hooked rod and set it in the tray, never letting a gripper cross the yellow line.
setup: Yellow line marker (8 mm wide, 0.40 m long along y) at x = 0.40. Guarded zone is x > 0.40. Block (40 x 40 x 40 mm, mass 0.05 kg, friction 0.4, red) at (0.58, 0.0) beyond hand reach (> 0.50 m). Hooked rod: shaft 300 x 20 x 20 mm + 20 x 60 x 20 mm cross-piece (T-hook at far end), mass 0.06 kg, friction 1.5, green, at (0.30, +0.25). Green tray 130 x 130 mm at (0.28, -0.30).
context: Remote hazardous retrieval, boundary safety compliance, tool-assisted reach extension in high-consequence containment zones where physical manipulators must remain strictly behind barrier limits.
scoring: Ladder: 0.25 for hooked rod held; 0.50 for block moved >= 60 mm (x <= 0.52); 0.75 for block outside guarded zone (x < 0.38 resting); 1.00 for block resting in green tray, no safety fault, rod set down outside zone, arms clear, held stable for 2.0 s (40 steps). Zero-gate: any arm TCP or gripper body crossing past yellow line boundary (x > 0.41 m) permanently latches FAULT = score 0.0.
fidelity: Rigid body PhysX dynamics with realistic friction (rod 1.5, block 0.4), compound hooked rod geometry, exact physical dimensions, and bimanual arm reach envelopes without simulated sensory shortcuts.
reset_notes: Block reset to guarded zone position at (0.58, 0.0), hooked rod reset to rest stance at (0.30, +0.25), grippers open at home stance.
